articles.summary: Relief and replacement vehicle assignments are one of the most frequent and least measured decisions in fleet leasing. Here is how they leak margin, and what changes when Fleet Intelligence ranks candidates transparently across the full requested window with the coordinator in control.
articles.title: The Margin Hiding in Your Relief Vehicle Queue

articles.summary: How Ridecell Engineering replaced a four-to-eight-hour manual release-notes process with a Dagster-orchestrated, Claude-drafted pipeline that covers four product lines and finishes in about 15 minutes, with confidence scoring to keep humans on the rows that need them.
articles.title: From 8 Hours to 15 Minutes: How We Automated Release Notes with AI
